description.text:
One of the UK's leading independent jewellers, David M Robinson is the official, exclusive agent for Patek Philippe, IWC, Panerai and Georg Jensen in Canary Wharf. In addition the company has a large Rolex espace and agencies for Tudor and Longines.

In addition to this impressive list of Swiss marques, the showroom also showcases an extensive range of engagement and diamond jewellery, all designed in house.  In addition to the main collections, DMR also offers a bespoke design service for those clients wanting something a little different.

David M Robinson, a master goldsmith and designer himself, is a two times winner of the DeBeers Diamond International Award, the Oscar of the diamond design world. The company, founded by David himself in 1968, has now been a feature in Jubilee Place since 2006.

Location: Jubilee Place
